what: Core & Main distributes water infrastructure products: pipes, valves, hydrants, meters and the fittings that municipalities and contractors use to build and repair water and sewer systems.
customers: Municipal water utilities, civil contractors and developers across the United States.
moat: Branches close to job sites holding inventory that a contractor needs the same day, in a market still largely served by small independent distributors it keeps acquiring.
risks: Municipal budgets and housing starts drive demand
A 5.8% net margin, normal for distribution
opportunities: 17 times earnings and 12.6 times free cash flow with $628M of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $5.0B to $7.6B in four years, partly by acquisition
Analysts see about 30% upside, and American water systems need decades of replacement spending
watch: Organic sales growth and the gross margin.
